title: Harness milestone 1: port the Jev-Flywheel bias studies and replay them offline
description: Done in Jev-Flywheel and being ported: package layout (engines, cues, tasks, metrics, record, report, CLI), the four Bias in Bios tasks, the gender-pronouns, race-name, race-fullname and age-inserted cues with floors, the Jev and laya-mlx records, bd replay reproducing every published number, RESULTS.md and README.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Status (2026-09-23): Done. Replay verified 1,306 numbers with no mismatch against the ported Jev-Flywheel studies; main pushed; v1.0.0 and v1.0.1 released. The Milestone 2 story (run the harness on your own data, BD-a27381) remains open and is not part of this milestone's close.

right_now_summary: The port is complete, and offline replay matches all 1,306 published numbers.
